India and Singapore Plan 3,000-km Cross-Border Power Link

India and Singapore are planning a 3,000-kilometer cross-border power transmission link that would traverse through ASEAN nations. The proposed corridor aims to connect India to Singapore via Myanmar, Thailand, and Malaysia.
